title: Set the day, time and place for The Group's Masterminds, Wellness and Pickleball circles

source.ref: The Group handoff (2026-10-19): Paste README 'Not in this paste (section B)'.

detail: Section B of The Group handoff. The three circles exist under the Network Space (seed NETWORK_CIRCLES, paste C7) with the placeholder meetup "...once June confirms the schedule." No schedule is invented. WAITS ON JUNE: the day, time and place for each circle. When she answers, set them in each Circle's settings (circle_profiles.meetup), or hand the answers to a thread to write a guarded paste.
notes: Filed 2026-10-20 at Daniel's request ("Put June's work in the backlog"). Open and blocked on June An's answers, not on code. Not parked: parking needs a ruling ADR (HYG-161).
